subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 6: 667/667; found+tested the daemon sequence-header registration blocker (test-only change)
body:
DONE V41 rev 6. Host only: no phone, nothing published, no commit. Product code unchanged since rev 5; the delta is one regression test plus the integration finding below.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V41 PASS 667/667
     628 checks in each of ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2 and TSan -O1 (same count in all three; was 612)
     + 39 real-n2vcu checks built twice; layout oracle 63 lines vs the kernel header; armv7 static
       asserts; arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile of both sources. 11.7 s, everything under /tmp/n2hw-V41.

FINDING (posted with the exact patch to hw-ip/opus-lead2, fact to hw-d01): daemon/vcodecd.c
read_sequence_header() allocates its bitstream with hw->dma_alloc() and passes the handle to
n2ap_venc_encode(), but that handle is not in the n2vc_dma registry, so the AP returns -EINVAL
before sending AP_IPIMSG_ENC_ENCODE. On the phone that is "sequence-header job failed: -22" at
every N2VCD_OPEN/start. New test t_v41.c:1494 reproduces the daemon sequence exactly: without
registration -EINVAL and n_encode==0; after n2vc_dma_guest_register(h,NULL,handle,pa,bytes,NULL)
the same call is 0 with bytes=29, enc_bsaddr==pa, enc_bsva==0x80000000|handle. The fix in vcodecd
is 4 lines (register after dma_alloc, guest_forget before dma_free, -ENOSYS tolerated for the
daemon test fake). Until IP applies it the first phone encode is blocked in the daemon, not in V41.

Re-verified integrations on the restarted tree (before the rev-6 test, unchanged since):
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V41/integration bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh
  -> H.264 seq-hdr 29 B, frame 115812 B key=1, bitstream 115841 B validated
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V41/integration-hevc bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session_hevc.sh
  -> HEVC seq-hdr 78 B, frame 43869 B key=1, bitstream 43947 B validated
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IV PASS 80/80

Not done (unchanged, full list in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md): no phone run;
single-plane NV12/NV21 source frames; no timestamps/ROI/QP map/HDR metadata; one job at a time;
ENCODE_DONE fields only a fallback; one session per IPI id; guest_map cannot record pa
(guest_register does); guest address space not reclaimed; close() assumes no concurrent dispatch.

Files changed this rev: gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/t_v41.c, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md.
Stay available for review findings and for the daemon-side fix verification.
